lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 visible vertical lines of varying lengths; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming more compressed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th line from the anterior is fragmented near the vertical midpoint; the 9th and 10th lines at the posterior are abbreviated, terminating before the upper or lower torso boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are located on the lower lateral haunch, positioned above the junction of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A single distinct diagonal white line segment is visible on the upper hind limb, oriented downward toward the posterior.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate trajectory, sweeping upward and outward from the skull base with a slight inward turn at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.5 times the width of a single horn base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal sections of both horns are heavily encrusted with dark, irregular organic debris (mud), obscuring the terminal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Two white spots on the snout/infraorbital region; high-contrast white markings on the lower limbs; prominent long-hair ventral fringe extending from the neck to the belly.
